description: Superuser/God only: create a UTF-8 text file in the shared UnClick Dropbox workspace. No delete operation exists. Set overwrite=true only to replace an existing file.

content.description: UTF-8 text content, at most 500,000 bytes.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing file (default false: an existing file is refused).

relative_path.description: File path below the area, for example '20260917 Handover.md'.

name: unclick_workspace_write
